misconceptions.description: Adding themes, animations, and clip art before the slide has a clear single message
misconceptions.trigger: learner spends time on transitions while three slides still carry no headline claim
misconceptions.feedback: Write the one-sentence headline for each slide first; decorate only after every slide states its point.

misconceptions.description: Treating a wall of bullet points as if it were slide structure
misconceptions.trigger: learner pastes a paragraph as eight bullets with no hierarchy or takeaway
misconceptions.feedback: Replace the bullet dump with one assertion headline plus at most three supporting points.

misconceptions.description: Believing a polished theme proves the deck is well structured
misconceptions.trigger: learner says the deck is done because the template looks consistent
misconceptions.feedback: Structure is the arc of headlines, not the theme. Read the headlines alone and check they tell the story.
